narrative: The collection's entry point and navigation hub, introducing the central thesis that experience may be fundamental to reality rather than a late biological accident, then laying out nine named reading trails through the archive — Epistemology, Frameworks, Feeling, Perception, Cosmic, Emergence, Boundary, AI, and Fractal — each organized around a distinct philosophical question, with every seedpod appearing on exactly one trail. Readers are invited to follow the trails sequentially or wander freely by numbered links, with the map dissolving into a web as connections accumulate.
